milestone.title: LiteLLM parity slice 5 — multi-modal & multi-provider
milestone.goal: a tenant can call embeddings, image-generation, and audio (STT+TTS) endpoints through the same authenticated, governed, accurately-billed proxy, served by a direct provider selected per model modality while OpenRouter still serves chat

provider-seam.title: Provider-selection seam + catalog modality/provider + OpenAI direct adapter

pricing-units.title: Per-unit pricing model (pricing_unit discriminator + quantity) with recorder dispatch

embeddings-endpoint.title: POST /v1/embeddings — token-priced, via provider seam; establishes reusable non-chat governance

images-endpoint.title: POST /v1/images/generations — per-image priced, via provider seam, reuses NonChatGovernance

audio-endpoints.title: POST /v1/audio/transcriptions (STT, per-second) + /v1/audio/speech (TTS, per-character streaming), reuses NonChatGovernance

v7-live-verify.title: v7 live close — OpenAI provider stub overlay + multi-modal billing double-pass
